Tenor saxophonist Javon Jackson was born in Carthage, Missouri on June 16, 1965. He attended the University of Denver and the Berklee College of Music, and cites his time with Art Blakey and Elvin Jones as his significant jazz education. Javon has recorded prolifically as a sideman and now leads his own quartet, recording on the Criss Cross label.
Javon was interviewed at Hamilton College on September 23, 2010 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
